retained.title: Consolidate the SwiftUI audio presentation-state boundary
retained.recommendation: Establish one MainActor observable presentation model, migrate views one state slice at a time, and remove local/defaults mirrors only after all consumers and tests use the authoritative owner.
preserve: current UI structure, copy, appearance, transitions, and accessibility
verification: external intent changes update Now Playing
restored repeat and rate match controls
queue mutations update QueueView and mini-player
SwiftUI Cause and Effect validates update scope
device playback, interruption, route, and restore tests
retained.unverified: SwiftUI invalidation and runtime behavior need Xcode, simulator, and device checks.

retained.title: Separate queue mutation from notification and persistence side effects
retained.recommendation: Inject QueueStatePersisting and finalize each logical mutation once: recalculate, notify changed values, create one snapshot, and request persistence once.
verification: one persistence request per logical mutation
persistence failure leaves memory state usable
device Time Profiler and File Activity at queue scale
retained.unverified: Latency magnitude needs Instruments and device checks.

retained.title: Give each Library section explicit request ownership and load phase
retained.recommendation: Store per-section request task or generation, set stored loading before suspension, reject stale responses, and model initial loading separately from pagination.
verification: cancellation on tab and query change
retained.unverified: Request timing and cancellation require executable Xcode async tests.

retained.title: Move filesystem operations and state out of FileManagerView
evidence: No tracked Fonic HiFiTests reference to FileManagerView
retained.recommendation: Introduce a filesystem service or actor and observable FileManagerViewModel; keep the view presentation-only and replace UIKit root-controller alert presentation with SwiftUI-owned state.
preserve: selection, confirmation, unique-copy naming, and visible copy
verification: temporary-directory list, sort, search, and root-bound tests
create, copy collision, delete partial failure, and cancellation tests
folder prompt and delete UI tests
retained.unverified: File-provider and security-scope behavior need simulator and device checks.

retained.title: Create one TrackDataActor insertion kernel before splitting responsibilities
retained.recommendation: Create one private actor-isolated no-save insertion helper used by single and batch creation; preserve save boundaries, then move only pure support concerns after parity tests pass.
retained.unverified: ModelActor macro expansion and strict concurrency need Xcode compilation.

retained.title: Own AsyncStream producer lifetime and cancellation in FileImportProcessor
retained.recommendation: Retain producer task handles, cancel them from continuation.onTermination, stop on terminated yields, and check cancellation before scheduling or committing work.
verification: cancellation during discovery and full concurrency
retained.unverified: Cancellation timing through SwiftData and file-provider I/O needs Xcode and device validation.

retained.title: Use one injectable process-metrics provider
retained.recommendation: Inject a narrow ProcessMetricsProviding boundary backed by the existing collector and remove direct Mach queries from AVAudioEngineAdapter.
verification: deterministic injected CPU and memory values
retained.unverified: Real metric fidelity needs device comparison with Instruments.

retained.title: Compile one canonical app/widget shared-data contract
evidence: Fonic HiFi/Shared/WidgetConstants.swift and Fonic HiFi Widget/Shared/WidgetConstants.swift
Fonic HiFi/Shared/WidgetPlaybackState.swift and Fonic HiFi Widget/Shared/WidgetPlaybackState.swift
Fonic HiFi/Shared/WidgetTrackInfo.swift and Fonic HiFi Widget/Shared/WidgetTrackInfo.swift
retained.recommendation: Compile one neutral shared source in both targets or use a tiny local package; until then, add semantic-diff CI and bidirectional fixtures.
preserve: Codable fields, defaults, and date strategy
retained.unverified: Target membership and extension compilation need Xcode.

screenedCandidates.title: Split largest diagnostics model files
screenedCandidates.reason: Size-only declaration aggregations with no executable, state, task, or I/O coupling.

screenedCandidates.title: Broadly decompose AVAudioEngineAdapter
screenedCandidates.reason: Audio graph and device-sensitive behavior make broad static-only decomposition unsafe; only metrics extraction was retained.

screenedCandidates.title: Move LibraryView private types into separate files
screenedCandidates.reason: Navigation-only churn without solving ownership or testability; permitted only inside WP4-R03.

screenedCandidates.title: Extract smart-playlist evaluator now
screenedCandidates.reason: Containing presentation path appears orphaned; cleanup/reachability decision comes first.

screenedCandidates.title: Consolidate ImportSession and FileImportProcessor
screenedCandidates.reason: ImportSession has no production constructor call and appears test-only; retention decision comes first.

screenedCandidates.title: Split GlassModifiers.swift
screenedCandidates.reason: Large aggregation of small named modifiers without high-value ownership or coupling evidence.
